articles.description: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.
articles.titleJa: インドネシアの工場火災で3人死亡、数十人が行方不明
articles.summary: インドネシアの菓子工場で火災が発生し、少なくとも3人が死亡、数十人が行方不明となっている。

articles.title: A new Nepal, an old neighbour - Balendra Shah's India test on first visit
articles.description: Trade, connectivity and regional cooperation will be on top of the agenda when Nepal's PM meets his India counterpart.
articles.titleJa: 新ネパール、旧隣国 - バレンドラ・シャー首相の初訪印における試練
articles.summary: ネパール首相がインド首相と会談し、貿易、接続性、地域協力が主要議題となる。

articles.title: Indonesian daycare principal jailed for five years over child abuse case
articles.description: Toddlers were found with their hands and feet tied with rags when police raided the centre in April.
articles.titleJa: インドネシアの保育園園長、児童虐待事件で禁錮5年
articles.summary: インドネシアの保育園で幼児が手足を縛られているのが発見され、園長が禁錮5年の判決を受けた。

articles.title: China issues Mount Fuji warning as family of missing climber offers reward
articles.description: The $75,000 reward offered by Chen Jie's family has sparked fears of more reckless climbing attempts.
articles.titleJa: 中国が富士山に警告、不明登山者の家族が報酬を提供
articles.summary: 不明の登山者家族が7万5千ドルの報酬を提示したことで、中国が富士山での無謀な登山行為に警告を発した。

articles.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
articles.description: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.
articles.titleJa: ミャンマーがロヒンギャ少数民族に対しジェノサイドを行ったと国連最高裁が裁定
articles.summary: 国際司法裁判所は、2017年の軍事弾圧で数千人が死亡した件について、ミャンマーがジェノサイドを行ったと裁定した。

articles.title: Cumin-laced fizzy sodas are giving cola giants a tough fight in India
articles.description: Cumin-laced sodas are capturing a bigger market share in India as demand for homegrown flavours goes up.
articles.titleJa: クミン入り炭酸飲料がインドでコーラ大手と激しい競争
articles.summary: クミン入り炭酸飲料がインドで人気を集め、国産フレーバーへの需要増により市場シェアを拡大している。

articles.title: Indian driver wins $1.3m in life-changing lottery prize
articles.description: A truck driver's fortunes have changed overnight after he won a Diwali lottery in the northern Indian state of Punjab.
articles.titleJa: インド人ドライバーが130万ドルの宝くじに当選し人生が一変
articles.summary: インド北部のパンジャブ州で、トラック運転手がディワリの宝くじに当選し、一夜にして運命が変わった。

articles.title: William and Kate meet PM Modi as they wrap up India tour
articles.description: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize
articles.titleJa: ウィリアム王子とキャサリン妃がインド訪問を終えモディ首相と会談
articles.summary: ウィリアム王子とキャサリン妃がインド訪問の最後にニューデリーでモディ首相と会談した。

articles.title: These dead pets were meant to be cremated - then their bodies appeared on a livestream
articles.description: Grieving Filipinos confront a distressing reality: their dogs and cats may not have received the send-off they paid for.
articles.titleJa: 火葬されるはずのペットの遺体がライブストリームに登場
articles.summary: フィリピンで、ペットが火葬されずライブストリームに遺体が出現し、飼い主たちが苦しんでいる。

articles.title: Bowen: Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications
articles.description: Lawyers will study the way in which The Gambia proved the crucial point that Myanmar intended to commit genocide, writes the BBC's international editor.
articles.titleJa: ボーウェン氏：ミャンマーのジェノサイド判決は歴史的で広範囲に影響を与える可能性
articles.summary: ミャンマーがジェノサイドを意図したとするガンビアの証明方法は、弁護士によって研究されるだろう。

articles.title: Trade-facilitating measures help offset rise in new G20 trade restrictions
articles.description: The number of tariff increases and other non-facilitating trade measures introduced by G20 economies rose sharply in the first half of 2026, and the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO's latest report on G20 trade measures. At the same time, G20 economies, representing around 80-85 per cent of global GDP and 75 per cent of international trade, introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to reinforce global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 貿易円滑化措置がG20の新たな貿易制限の増加を相殺するのに貢献
articles.summary: G20諸国による新たな貿易制限が増加する中、貿易円滑化措置が導入され、世界貿易の流れを支えています。

articles.title: EU launches safeguard investigation into certain composite input materials
articles.description: On 23 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (23 November 2026), a safeguard investigation into imports of certain composite input materials.
articles.titleJa: EU、特定複合材に関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 2026年11月23日、EUは特定の複合材の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知しました。

articles.title: Panama submits request to join Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement
articles.description: Panama has submitted a request to join the 2015 Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA II), the Chair of the Committee of Participants on the Expansion of Trade in Information Technology Products, Mr Shih-Chun Weng of Chinese Taipei, informed members at a meeting on 19 November. Panama said joining ITA II will help it to advance its goal of a more knowledge-based, innovation-driven and technologically advanced economy.
articles.titleJa: パナマ、情報技術協定の拡大への参加を申請
articles.summary: パナマは情報技術協定（ITA II）への参加を申請し、知識ベース経済への移行を目指しています。

articles.title: Applications open for WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues
articles.description: The Secretariat of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the Secretariat of the World Trade Organization (WTO) are now accepting applications for the WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues for Senior Government Officials. The activity will take place from 1 to 12 February 2027 at the headquarters of the WIPO and of the WTO in Geneva, Switzerland.
articles.titleJa: WIPO-WTO知的財産問題に関する幹部プログラムの参加者募集開始
articles.summary: WIPOとWTOが2027年2月にジュネーブで開催する、知的財産問題に関する幹部プログラムの申請受付を開始しました。

articles.title: Spotlight on trade fundamentals at annual WTO student event
articles.description: Over 200 students joined policymakers, executives and thought leaders on 18 November at the WTO to discuss trade fundamentals at the WTO's annual student-only event on trade, titled WTO 101: Trade Rules!. Now in its third year, the event saw spirited discussions on the key issues facing the multilateral system and its implications for the next generation.
articles.titleJa: WTO年次学生イベントで貿易の基本に焦点
articles.summary: 200人以上の学生がWTOの年次イベントに参加し、多角的貿易システムとその次世代への影響について議論しました。

articles.title: Trade Policy Review: Peru
articles.description: The sixth review of the trade policies and practices of Peru takes place on 18 and 20 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Peru.
articles.titleJa: 貿易政策レビュー：ペルー
articles.summary: ペルーの貿易政策と慣行に関する第6回レビューが2026年11月18日と20日に開催されます。

articles.title: New trade-restrictive measures surge but WTO members step up trade facilitation efforts
articles.description: The pace of newly-introduced tariffs and other non-facilitating measures rose sharply in the first half of 2026, while the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO Director-General's latest annual overview of developments in the international trading environment. At the same time, WTO members introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to sustain global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 新たな貿易制限措置が急増するも、WTO加盟国は貿易円滑化努力を強化
articles.summary: 貿易制限措置は増加傾向にあるものの、WTO加盟国は貿易円滑化努力を強化し、世界貿易を支えています。

articles.title: DDG Nordquist: Global trade is adapting, not retreating
articles.description: Global trade has demonstrated remarkable resilience despite geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions and trade restrictions, with businesses adapting through diversification and new trading partnerships, Deputy Director-General DJ Nordquist said at the 16th Asian Logistics, Maritime and Aviation Conference in Hong Kong, China, on 16 November. Highlighting stronger-than-expected trade growth and the continued importance of WTO rules, she called for more resilient global supply chains, deeper international cooperation and reforms to ensure the multilateral trading system remains fit for today's challenges. The text of her speech is below.
articles.titleJa: ノードキスト事務次長：世界貿易は後退ではなく適応している
articles.summary: ノードキスト事務次長は、世界貿易が地政学的緊張にもかかわらず回復力を示し、適応していると述べました。

articles.title: Goods Council agrees to modernize notification reporting, reviews trade concerns
articles.description: The WTO's Council for Trade in Goods (CTG) adopted a decision to improve annual reporting on notifications and the WTO Notifications Portal. It also reviewed an updated Secretariat report indicating that 35% of the 241 trade concerns raised in the Council between 1995 and May 2026 had been reported as fully or partially resolved. Members considered 38 trade concerns, including five raised for the first time, and discussed several issues relating to tariff renegotiations under Article XXVIII of the GATT.
articles.titleJa: 物品理事会、通知報告の近代化に合意、貿易懸念をレビュー
articles.summary: WTO物品理事会は通知報告の改善に合意し、貿易懸念のレビューを行いました。

articles.title: Ireland contributes EUR 200,000 to strengthen trade opportunities in developing countries
articles.description: Ireland is contributing EUR 200,000 (approximately CHF 185,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) in 2026 to strengthen sanitary and phytosanitary capacity in developing and least-developed countries. The contribution will support STDF activities that help countries meet international food safety and animal and plant health standards, as well as facilitate safe and inclusive trade.
articles.titleJa: アイルランド、発展途上国の貿易機会強化のため20万ユーロを拠出
articles.summary: アイルランドは、発展途上国の食品安全および動植物衛生基準強化のため、STDFに20万ユーロを拠出します。
